summary: Workflow task failures after Workflow.getVersion() calls mask the original exception with a generic 'runner-closed' error, preventing developers from seeing the actual cause of failure.
userImpact: Developers cannot diagnose workflow failures when exceptions occur after getVersion() calls, seeing only a generic 'runner-closed' error instead of the actual exception.
rootCause: The deterministic runner closes and raises a generic error before the original workflow exception can be properly propagated through the version state machine.
proposedFix: Preserve and report the original exception instead of masking it with the runner-closed error.
keyQuote: Workflow task failed with an internal Java SDK runner-closed error...masking the original exception.
